title: IDE sidebar (450 px) test-suite parallelization distribution
what: Median test duration reduction (% or s) or the serial/parallel_8w medians (s)

reader_questions.question: How much faster is the median test-suite run with 8 parallel workers?
reader_questions.expected: Median dropped 58.6% (110 s faster, from 188 s to 78 s).

reader_questions.question: Do the bulk distributions of serial and parallel_8w overlap?
reader_questions.expected: Hardly at all; the IQRs are cleanly separated across the 80 runs per mode.

reader_questions.question: What caveat appears in the upper tail of parallel_8w?
reader_questions.expected: A few slow tail runs reach ~140–158 s (p95 ≈ 134 s), nearly double the parallel median.
